maddeler.e:
تشترعون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِعُونَ (taštariʕūna) /taʃ.ta.ri.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# تُشْتَرَعُونَ (tuštaraʕūna) /tuʃ.ta.ra.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
